In detail

Cambridgeshire Constabulary recorded 291 crimes inside this ward's official boundary over the 3 months to July 2026 — 10.9 per 1,000 residents, the 5th highest rate of Cambridge's 14 wards. The daytime score here is driven by shoplifting (30), bicycle theft (7), drugs (2); the evening/night score by violent crime (21), anti social behaviour (16), public order (3). Rated against the average of the city's own wards, never against another city.

Frequently asked questions

Is West Chesterton safe?

Wandroz currently rates West Chesterton in Cambridge as roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in Cambridge during the day and relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in Cambridge at night. This rating is derived from Cambridgeshire Constabulary street-level crime records published at data.police.uk — an official statistic, not an assessment. High-footfall tourist, transit or shopping areas can read higher on this kind of measure without that meaning elevated risk per visit, since these statistics are normalised against registered residents rather than footfall — see the note on this page and the methodology page for the full caveats.

Is West Chesterton safe at night?

At night, West Chesterton is rated as relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in Cambridge. If you're unsure, it's worth checking recent local reviews for your specific street or block, since a neighbourhood-wide rating can't capture block-by-block variation.

Is West Chesterton a good area to stay in as a tourist?

West Chesterton's day rating (roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in Cambridge) is the more relevant one for typical daytime tourist activity; check the night rating too if you'll be out late.
